The solver of a model

Source: R/method.R
pmx_ode_method.Rd

Every model has a default solver, the most specific its class allows (design §4.3, D6): the closed form for a linCmt() model, the matrix exponential for a linear one of up to 20 compartments, LSODA otherwise. pmx_ode_method(model) says which a model uses; pmx_ode_method(model, method) returns a copy that uses method. pmx_ode_info() says why.

Usage

pmx_ode_method(model, method)

Arguments

model

A model.

method

"auto" (the default choice), "closed" (closed-form models only), "expm" (closed-form or linear models of up to 20 compartments), "lsoda" or "dopri5" (Dormand-Prince 5(4)).

Value

The method in use, or, given method, the model with it.

Errors

pmx_ode_error_argument for a method the model's class cannot take.

Examples

m <- pmx_ode_model({
  d/dt(central) <- -k * central
})
pmx_ode_method(m)
#> [1] "expm"
pmx_ode_method(pmx_ode_method(m, "lsoda"))
#> [1] "lsoda"
